questions.question: The radius and slant height of a cone are in the ratio 5 ∶ 7. If its curved surface area is 1347.5 cm². find its radius. (Use π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
Given:

The radius and slant height of a cone = 5 ∶ 7

Curved surface area = 1347.5 cm2

Formula used: 

Volume of cone = (1/3) π r2 h

Slant height = √(h2 + r2) 

Where,

r = Radius of the cone

h = Height of the cone

l = slant height

Curved surface area = πrl

Calculation

let the radius and height of the cone be 5x and 7x.

Curved surface area = πrl = 1347.5 

⇒ 22/7 × 5x × 7x = 1347.5 

⇒ 2 × 5x × x = 122.5 

⇒ x² = 12.25

⇒ x = 3.5 cm

5x → 5 × 3.5 = 17.5 cm

**The radius of a cone is 17.5 cm.**

questions.question: A sum of ₹12,000 amounts to ₹15,000 in 5 years at the rate of simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution:
Given:

Principal = Rs. 12000

Amount = Rs. 15000

Time = 5 years

Formula used:

SI = (PRT)/100

A = P + SI

where, 

SI = Simple interest, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time and A = Amount

Calculations:

According to the question, we have

Simple interest 

⇒ SI = Rs. 15000 - Rs. 12000

⇒ SI = Rs. 3000

Now, according to the formula used

⇒ SI = (PRT)/100

⇒ 3000 = (12000 × R × 5)/100

⇒ 3000 = 600R

⇒ R = 5

⇒ R = 5%

∴ The Rate of interest per annum is 5%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** SI = Rs. 15000 - Rs. 12000 = 3000

The rate in SI is the interest of one year on the given principle.

Rs. 3000 is the interest of 5 years, hence for one year:

⇒ 3000/5 = 600

Rate = 600/12000 × 100 = 5%

questions.question: A dealer offers a discount of 10% on the marked price of an article and still makes a profit of 20%. If the cost price of the article is ₹540, then find the marked price (in ₹) of the article.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of Cost Price (CP) to Marked Price (MP) can be calculated directly using the profit and discount percentages.

CP : MP = (100 − D%) : (100 + P%)

CP : MP = (100 − 10) : (100 + 20) = 90 : 120 = 3 : 4

Since 3 units represent the given CP of ₹540, 1 unit = 540 ÷ 3 = ₹180.

Therefore, MP = 4 units = 4 × 180 = ₹720.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹720.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹540

Discount (D) = 10%

Profit (P) = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 + P%) ÷ 100

Marked Price (MP) = SP × 100 ÷ (100 − D%)

questions.question: The lengths of the two sides adjacent to the right angle of a right-angled triangle are 1.6 cm and 6.3 cm. Find the length of the hypotenuse.
questions.solution:
**Given**

The lengths of the two sides adjacent to the right angle are 1.6 cm and 6.3 cm.

**Concept used**

The two sides adjacent to the right angle of a right-angled triangle are perpendicular and base.

P² + B² = H²

**Calculation**

H² = 1.6² + 6.3²

H2 = 2.56 + 39.69

H2 = 42.25

H = 6.5 cm

**The length of the hypotenuse is 6.5 cm.**

questions.question: The total distance in a journey is 750 km. A bus travels the first 200 km at a speed of 40 kmph. Find the speed of the bus (in kmph) for the next 550 km such that the average speed of the bus is 50 kmph.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time for the journey = 750 ÷ 50 = 15 hours.

Time spent on the first 200 km = 200 ÷ 40 = 5 hours.

Remaining time for the next 550 km = 15 − 5 = 10 hours.

Required speed for remaining distance = 550 ÷ 10 = 55 kmph.

**∴ The correct answer is 55 kmph.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance = 750 km

Distance of 1st part = 200 km, Speed of 1st part = 40 kmph

Distance of 2ⁿd part = 550 km

Overall average speed = 50 kmph

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 
• 
 
 
• 
 
 
 
 
 200 km
 550 km
 Total Distance: 750 km (Avg Speed: 50 kmph)
 
 Speed = 40 kmph
 Time = 5 hrs
 
 Speed = ? kmph
 Time = 10 hrs
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Time = Total Distance ÷ Average Speed

⇒ Total Time = 750 ÷ 50 = 15 hours

⇒ Time taken for the first 200 km = Distance ÷ Speed = 200 ÷ 40 = 5 hours

⇒ Time remaining for the next 550 km = Total Time − Time taken for the first part

⇒ Time remaining = 15 − 5 = 10 hours

⇒ Required speed for the next 550 km = Distance ÷ Time

⇒ Required speed = 550 ÷ 10 = 55 kmph

**∴ The correct answer is 55 kmph.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

Average speed is the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken. It is not simply the arithmetic mean of the different speeds.

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If an object covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed over the entire journey is directly calculated using the formula 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds. When moving in the same direction, it is the difference between their individual speeds.

questions.question: If x² + y² + z² =2(x + z - 1), then the value of x³ + y³ + z³ is equal to:
questions.solution:
**Given**

x2 + y2 + z2 = 2(x + z - 1)

**Formula used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation**

x² + y² + z² = 2(x + z - 1)

⇒ x² + y² + z² = 2x + 2z - 2

⇒ x² - 2x + 1 + z² – 2z + 1 + y² = 0

⇒ (x - 1)² + (z – 1)² + y² = 0

As we know square of any real number is never negative, ∴ only way above sum will add up to 0 is individual squares are of value 0.

∴ (x - 1)² = 0

⇒ x = 1

& (z – 1)² = 0

⇒ z = 1

y² = 0

⇒ y = 0

∴ x³ + y³ + z³ = (1)³ + 0³ + 1³

⇒ x³ + y³ + z³ = 2

**The answer is 2.**

questions.question: If cos θ - sin θ = 0, then (sin⁸ θ + cos⁸ θ) is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Given cos θ − sin θ = 0, which implies tan θ = 1.

This means the angle θ = 45°.

At θ = 45°, sin θ = 1/√2 and cos θ = 1/√2.

Substitute the values: (1/√2)⁸ + (1/√2)⁸

⇒ 1/16 + 1/16 = 2/16 = 1/8.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/8.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

cos θ − sin θ = 0

**Calculations:**

⇒ cos θ = sin θ

Squaring both sides, we get:

⇒ cos² θ = sin² θ

Using the standard trigonometric identity:

⇒ sin² θ + cos² θ = 1

Substituting cos² θ with sin² θ:

⇒ sin² θ + sin² θ = 1

⇒ 2sin² θ = 1

⇒ sin² θ = 1/2 and cos² θ = 1/2

Now, we need to find the value of (sin⁸ θ + cos⁸ θ):

⇒ (sin² θ)⁴ + (cos² θ)⁴

⇒ (1/2)⁴ + (1/2)⁴

⇒ 1/16 + 1/16

⇒ 2/16 = 1/8

**∴ The correct answer is 1/8.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 | sec²θ − tan²θ = 1 | cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1

Important Higher Power Expansions

sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ = 1 − 2sin²θ cos²θ | sin⁶θ + cos⁶θ = 1 − 3sin²θ cos²θ

Equalities at 45°

In the first quadrant, sin θ = cos θ only when θ = 45°. Similarly, tan θ = cot θ and sec θ = cosec θ are equal at θ = 45°.
</p

questions.question: Brijesh can complete a work in 4 days, Ashish in 5 days, and Anand in 10 days. What will be the time taken by Brijesh, Ashish, and Anand to complete the work together?
questions.solution:
Given: 

Brijesh can complete a work in 4 days.

Ashish can complete the same work in 5 days.

Anand can complete the same work in 10 days.

Concept used:

Entire work = Work done each day × Time taken to finish the entire work 

Calculation:

LCM (4, 5 and 10) = 20

Let the entire work be given by the LCM of the time taken by Brijesh, Ashish & Anand

So, the entire work = 20 units

Now,

Brijesh does each day = 20 ÷ 4 = 5 units

Ashish does each day = 20 ÷ 5 = 4 units

Anand does each day = 20 ÷ 10 = 2 units

Together they will do the remaining work = 20/11

= 1(9/11) days

The answer is **1(9/11) days**

S.P = C.P(1 +/- r/100)

where, r = gain/loss%

⇒ x = 6520 × (100/125) × (100/90)
